_about: Single source of truth for the risk score. Read by agent/tools/scoring.py (agent) and web/scoring.js (web form). Change numbers here, never in code. All values are PROTOTYPE ASSUMPTIONS until calibrated on real data (Yuvraj).

age._rule: 0 points at or below min_years, scales linearly to max at full_years. Unknown year built = max points.

psc._rule: Ship PSC index blended with a peer baseline by credibility Z = n / (n + k), n = inspections in the last 36 months.

flag._rule: Paris MOU white/grey/black list. Unknown scored like grey.

class_society._rule: IACS member society = 0. Non-IACS or unknown = max.

class_status._rule: Suspended or withdrawn class forces DECLINE: hull cover requires class to be maintained.

vessel_type._rule: Relative base risk by ship type. Prototype judgment, to be replaced by casualty-rate data.

owner._rule: Fleet-wide PSC record of the registered owner (last 36 months), blended with an industry baseline by Z = n / (n + k), n = fleet inspections.

recommendation._rule: Bands on the total score (0-100). Overrides always win.

pricing._rule: premium = base_rate x insured value x relativity x (1 + loading); relativity = intercept + slope x total score, so score 50 = 1.0x.
